description: This file defines the ContentPartDefinitionBuilder class used for constructing and configuring ContentPartDefinition objects, including managing fields and settings within OrchardCore's content management system.

classes.name: ContentPartDefinitionBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and configuring ContentPartDefinition instances, including managing fields, settings, and validation.

classes.name: ContentPartDefinitionBuilder.FieldConfigurerImpl
classes.description: A nested class implementing configuration logic for individual content part fields during builder configuration.

methods.name: ContentPartDefinitionBuilder()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new builder with a null ContentPartDefinition.

methods.name: ContentPartDefinitionBuilder(ContentPartDefinition existing)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with an existing ContentPartDefinition, copying its fields and settings.

methods.name: Build()
methods.description: Validates the name and constructs a new ContentPartDefinition with current settings.

methods.name: Named(string name)
methods.description: Sets the name of the content part being built.

methods.name: RemoveField(string fieldName)
methods.description: Removes a field by name from the content part.

methods.name: MergeSettings(JsonObject settings)
methods.description: Merges provided JSON settings into the builder's settings.

methods.name: MergeSettings<T>(Action<T> setting) where T : class, new()
methods.description: Merges specific settings of type T into the builder's settings.

methods.name: WithSettings<T>(T settings)
methods.description: Sets the entire settings object of type T.

methods.name: WithField(string fieldName)
methods.description: Adds a field with the specified name using default configuration.

methods.name: WithField(string fieldName, Action<ContentPartFieldDefinitionBuilder> configuration)
methods.description: Adds or replaces a field with custom configuration.

methods.name: WithField<TField>(string fieldName)
methods.description: Adds a field of a specific type with default configuration.

methods.name: WithField<TField>(string fieldName, Action<ContentPartFieldDefinitionBuilder> configuration)
methods.description: Adds or replaces a field of a specific type with custom configuration.

methods.name: WithFieldAsync<TField>(string fieldName, Func<ContentPartFieldDefinitionBuilder, Task> configuration)
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or replaces a field of a specific type with custom async configuration.

methods.name: WithFieldAsync(string fieldName, Func<ContentPartFieldDefinitionBuilder, Task> configurationAsync)
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or replaces a field with custom async configuration.
